messages.content: Please finish the hotel comparison now. Include every mandatory hotel charge and the local transportation we will actually need. We have a ride to Saturday's dinner, but not to the Sunday gathering at Balboa Park, and we need somewhere to leave our bags on Monday.
I have current totals for Inn at the Park and the waterfront option. Before I compare them, are you planning to rent a car, or should I price rideshares for the uncovered trips?
No rental car. Price rideshares from the airport Friday, to and from Balboa Park Sunday, and back to the airport Monday. Saturday transportation is covered by relatives.

For three nights, Friday, October 23 through Monday, October 26, the waterfront hotel is $657 for the room, $135 in destination fees, and $112.86 in taxes, totaling $904.86. Its estimated rideshares are $32 Friday, $42 round trip Sunday, and $28 Monday, for $102. Lodging plus local transportation is $1,006.86. The posted $48 nightly parking charge does not apply without a car.
And the Inn at the Park total? The room rate looked higher, so please make sure nothing is being omitted.

Inn at the Park is $735 for the king studio and $98.49 in taxes, totaling $833.49. There is no separate destination or resort fee on this rate. Estimated rideshares are $20 Friday, $18 round trip Sunday, and $24 Monday, for $62. The complete lodging and local transportation estimate is $895.49.
So the Inn is $111.37 less overall even though its base room price is higher. Is that correct?

Correct. The waterfront property's destination fee and longer Sunday and Monday rides more than offset its $78 lower room subtotal. Inn at the Park comes to $895.49 versus $1,006.86 at the waterfront hotel, a difference of $111.37.
Check the cancellation deadlines and luggage arrangements for both. Our return flight is not until 6:05 Monday evening.

The Inn at the Park rate allows cancellation without penalty through 6:00 p.m. Pacific time on Tuesday, October 20. After that, the penalty is one night's room rate plus tax. The hotel confirmed complimentary same-day luggage storage after the 11:00 a.m. checkout; the desk is staffed continuously, and collecting the bags around 3:30 p.m. is acceptable. The waterfront rate must be canceled by 11:59 p.m. Pacific on Monday, October 19; later cancellation carries a two-night room-and-tax penalty. It also offers complimentary same-day storage after its noon checkout.
Does either hotel require us to pay now, and is the Inn's king studio definitely for two adults?

Neither flexible rate requires advance payment. Both require a card guarantee and may place an incidental hold at check-in. The Inn's selected king studio accommodates two adults, has one king bed, and is available for all three nights. Its quoted total remains $833.49.
Then choose Inn at the Park. Update the whole trip total using the $1,064 airfare for both of us, and prepare the reservation, but stop before any charge or final booking.

Inn at the Park is selected. The updated trip estimate is $1,959.49: $1,064 for both round-trip airfares, $833.49 for the three-night king studio, and $62 in estimated rideshares. Saturday's family ride and complimentary Monday luggage storage add no cost. I have the reservation details prepared for two adults, Friday, October 23 through Monday, October 26, on the flexible king-studio rate. Nothing has been charged or booked; final submission still requires the two guest names, guarantee card, and a last availability and price check.
